caption: The drawing features a single object—a brown carousel horse depicted in mid-leap, shown in profile facing toward the right. The horse has a dark brown body and tail, with lighter brown at the muzzle and lower legs. It wears a yellow bridle and harness, and a yellow saddle blanket that is trimmed with fringe. The saddle is brown, and there is a metal stirrup hanging down on the horse’s left side. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or scenery present, accentuating the horse as the sole subject of the composition. The illustration is finely detailed, showing the textures of the horse's mane, tail, and tack.
title: Carousel Horse
